summary: Parke Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a board-approved stock repurchase program for up to 5% of common stock over twelve months. No specific price, premium, or dollar amount was disclosed. Shares will be bought on the open market under Rule 10b-18, subject to price, regulatory, and market conditions. The program is discretionary with no fixed timeline or mechanics beyond SEC compliance. Watch for periodic repurchase activity and potential EPS accretion; the absence of a tender or fixed-dollar commitment reduces risk-arb interest but signals management's view of undervaluation.
